text:
anya: Heads-up — I'm seeing a large delta between the metering dashboard and invoice totals for 2026-02-12 02:00-03:30 UTC. Dashboard shows ~240M tokens, invoice ~150M. Customers (Acme, Faber) flagged billing spikes/credits. Investigating now.

support_jen: Which customers opened tickets? Any P0?

anya: Acme is P0, they reported missing usage then unexpected invoice credits. Faber asked why their token count is lower than expected. Tickets: #AC-1987, #FB-443.

samir: Looking at the events stream — seems like our metering consumer lagged then stalled. Kafka offsets for partition 7 jumped back at 02:12 UTC then consumer restarted around 03:05.

kafka-monitor: :warning: consumer-group metering-consumer lag > 1M messages for partitions [6,7,8] at 02:20 UTC; consumer rebalanced at 03:04 UTC.

ryan: Any evidence of dropped events? We have dedupe but if consumer crashed before ack-ing we might have a hole.

anya: I pulled raw S3 shard files for 02:00-03:30 and see a gap: last-successful-processed event at 02:11:43, next processed at 03:06:02. There are unprocessed gz files present.

samir: That suggests the consumer failed and the replay didn't run automatically. Possible cause: malformed event triggered a JSON.parse exception in metering-consumer at 02:11:40. Logs: 
```
ERROR metering-consumer parseEvent at eventId=ev_9A3: Unexpected token "\u0000" in JSON at position 128
stack: TypeError: Failed to parse
```

lee: We saw similar with malformed attachments last quarter. Is schema validation catching this?

samir: Validator should have thrown upstream; looks like an internal producer wrote a malformed payload (null byte). We need to 1) replay the missing files, 2) patch consumer to skip/bury bad events, 3) reconcile counts and bill adjustments.

support_jen: Customers already asking for timeline + credits. Suggest providing an interim note: apologizing, explaining ingestion lag + replay plan, ETA.

anya: Proposed playbook:
- run replay tool on S3 prefix `s3://metering-archive/2026/02/12/02{00..30}` with dedupe flag
- run reconciliation SQL to compute delta per-customer
- apply credits for under-billed customers or bill adjustments if over-billed
- post incident report and follow-up commit

ryan: Command to run (safe mode):
```
# dry run, will print counts
./tools/replay_metering --prefix s3://metering-archive/2026/02/12/02 --start 02:00 --end 03:30 --dedupe --dry-run
```

samir: After dry-run, run without --dry-run and watch consumer. Use `--max-parallel=4` to reduce stress. Also add `--skip-corrupt` to the tool until we patch validator.

opsbot: :white_check_mark: replay job enqueued by anya (job id replay-20260212-01). Estimated runtime 40m.

anya: Running dry-run now. I'll paste initial reconciliation query I ran: 
```
-- get tokens from metering_raw for window
SELECT customer_id, SUM(tokens) as tokens_raw
FROM metering_raw
WHERE event_time >= '2026-02-12T02:00:00Z' AND event_time < '2026-02-12T03:30:00Z'
GROUP BY customer_id;
```

anya: Dry-run output shows ~85M tokens missing total; Acme missing ~22M, Faber ~14M.

support_jen: Okay, customers want ETA and whether they will be auto-credited. Ops to confirm policy with billing.

billing-bot: Noting: policy_auto_credit = true for enterprise tier. Pending reconciliation delta will trigger credits after QA sign-off.

lee: I can patch the consumer quick fix to skip null-byte events and log them to a quarantine bucket. Will roll canary to one partition.

samir: Good. After that we should replay and then run reconciliation. Important: dedupe algorithm uses event_id + timestamp; ensure replay retains those fields.

anya: Replay started (replay-20260212-01). Monitoring counts now.

opsbot: replay-20260212-01 progress: 30% complete, processed 14/45 files, no fatal errors.

ryan: When replay finishes, run reconciliation script: `scripts/reconcile_metering --start 2026-02-12T02:00 --end 2026-02-12T03:30 --output ./recon-20260212.csv`

anya: Replay finished. Reconciled totals match invoice except for 2 events that had duplicated event_id — they're being deduped and net effect is zero. Final delta: 0 tokens missing after replay.

support_jen: Awesome. Can we confirm credits applied for Acme & Faber now?

billing-bot: Credits queued: Acme credit 22,143,112 tokens -> $2,214.31; Faber credit 14,002,000 tokens -> $1,400.20. Pending manual QA sign-off by finance.

lee: Follow-ups: 1) add stricter schema validation on producer path, 2) add `--skip-corrupt` default to replay tool, 3) make consumer auto-skip and quarantine corrupt events, 4) add alert for consumer-error-rate > 0.1%.

samir: I'll open the PRs and link here. Also creating runbook update for incident.

anya: Drafting customer communication now. Will notify Acme & Faber with timeline, credit amounts, and root cause (malformed event caused consumer crash -> ingestion lag -> replay).

support_jen: Please post the final incident summary in #incidents and tag customers. Great work everyone. :clap:

anya: Incident closed for now. Will update with PR links and postmortem within 48h.
